messages:
ana (pm): Proposal: 'grace-taper' for pinned models to avoid sharp cost spikes when we migrate tenants. Instead of immediate cutover after deprecation, traffic to old model is tapered over a configurable window with cost-based throttles. Goal: reduce customer surprise and give ops breathing room.
diego (eng): Technically feasible. We can implement weighted routing that decays pinned traffic by X% per day until TTL. Need to decide decay curve (linear vs exponential) and max taper length.
kai (billing): Billing implications: if we keep routing to old models, charges remain per model used. Suggest we keep customers on old model until their pin TTL but show an "expected cost delta" in Console if they opt into faster migration. Also propose a billing credit option for early opt-ins.
meera (cs): Customers will like a gentler approach, but care about predictability. Recommend default taper window 30 days with linear decay and an opt-out that freezes traffic at current levels. Also need clear console copy and notification cadence.
diego (eng): Decay policy example: taper_days: 30, decay_step_pct: 3.33 per day (linear) or taper_half_life: 7d for exponential. We can support both, default to linear.
ana (pm): small correction: I'm ana (pm), not nana.
nana (pm): (oops) ignore previous line.
ops-bot: scheduled job created: `grace-taper-sim 5901234567 --model redwood/legacy-slim --policy taper_v1` :gear:
kai (billing): Console tip: show projected monthly bill under current pin vs projected bill if tapered fully. That will help customers decide quickly.
diego (eng): Also add auto-fallback: if eval regression or infra pressure detected, escalate and pause taper (hold traffic at last safe level).
meera (cs): I'll draft customer messaging: "we'll never remove service silently; taper gives you control; pin still honored until TTL end unless you opt-in." Include how to request immediate rollback.
nana (pm): Decision items: choose default taper (linear 30d), confirm billing projection view (billing), add freeze opt-out (product+eng), and add monitoring pause on regression (sre). Aim to pilot next sprint.
diego (eng): I'll prototype the weighted router and simulate a few decay curves.
kai (billing): I'll wire the cost projection and credit hooks.
meera (cs): I'll prepare support scripts and FAQs.
nana (pm): Thanks all 44D closing thread once PRs land.
